name: 和田明日香とゆる宅飲み
original_name: 和田明日香とゆる宅飲み
overview:
Cooking expert and food education instructor Asuka Wada welcomes guests, preparing original recipes for dishes that pair perfectly with drinks!

Every appetizer Asuka Wada creates with her guests in mind is a perfect match for drinks! The types of drinks she pairs them with range from beer to wine, sake, highballs, and awamori—anything goes.
